passages.heading: SIMPLE algorithm
passages.why: The page is a stub: it lists the SIMPLE steps but does not describe SIMPLEC or the consistent switch.

passages.heading: SIMPLE
passages.why: Momentum relaxation is applied to the matrix, at step 4 of the loop, before the momentum equations are solved.

passages.heading: SIMPLE
passages.why: Pressure is under-relaxed as a field at step 9 of the loop, after the flux correction and before the velocity is corrected.

passages.heading: SIMPLEC
passages.why: SIMPLEC, the variant the consistent option switches on, is listed with its authors only; the studio keeps plain SIMPLE.
